name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based 1-2 frame press and wave release input buffer.

buffer-ticks.name: Max Ticks
buffer-ticks.description: Largest delay the buffer may add, in 240 TPS ticks (1 tick = 4.17 ms). Wave is capped at 8. F6 also sets this (2 / 4 / 8 / 16).

buffer-min-ticks.name: Min Ticks
buffer-min-ticks.description: Smallest delay the buffer will use. With Min 1 and Max 4 it only delays by 1 to 4 ticks. If Min is above Max, Max is used.

randomize.name: Randomize (ticks)
randomize.description: 0 = always the smallest safe delay (like the original). Above 0 = the search starts at a random delay up to this many ticks above Min, and takes the first safe one from there.

buffer-releases.name: Releases
buffer-releases.description: Also buffer early releases for wave and robot (and ship, if Ship is on).

window-size.name: Window Size (%)
window-size.description: On top of the automatic sizing (1x on 1080p, 1.33x on 1440p).
